question: By what means does the unfolding of true knowledge occur according to this teaching?
premises: The unfolding of knowledge is said to occur in this way.
Other forms of service do not produce it.
The statement is addressed to the fair one.
inference: True knowledge unfolds through this practice alone, not through other services.
uncertainties: The referent of evaṃ depends on the preceding ritual description.
plain_english: O fair one, the unfolding of knowledge arises in this way, and not by any other service.
